name: 155. Fixture-gated coverage (fixtures supplied through collection variables)
description: Rows that need an account resource the harness cannot create, expressed as [PREVIEW] cases that read the resource from a collection variable. Nothing runs by default (include_preview=1 is required) and every variable defaults to a clearly fake placeholder. Set the variable with --env-var or --global-var, for example --env-var openaiVectorStoreId=vs_abc. Variables: openaiVectorStoreId (155.1); bedrockBatchRoleArn/bedrockBatchInputS3Uri/bedrockBatchOutputS3Uri/bedrockBatchModelId (155.5a-c, which share h155JobArnEnc and must run in order); bedrockProvisionedModelArn, bedrockAppInferenceProfileArn, bedrockPromptArn (155.6-155.8; the value must be URL-encoded because it sits in the path); bedrockVideoB64 (155.9, a base64 mp4); vertexAiSearchDatastore and vertexRagCorpus (155.10/155.11); azureSearchEndpoint/azureSearchIndex/azureSearchKey (155.12); vertexGemmaModel (155.15, a self-deployed endpoint); anthropicSettledBatchId (155.16). Sora and Veo (155.3/155.4) are paid and slow: create only, no polling. Spend-limit ids go through extra-header forwarding (x-bf-eh-x-goog-spend-limit-id reaches Vertex as x-goog-spend-limit-id, pinned by 161.12); its Provisioned Throughput analog is service_tier priority/flex, sent to Vertex as the X-Vertex-AI-LLM-Shared-Request-Type header on the global endpoint (155.18); that header is not observable from the response, so the case asserts the request still succeeds. The Bedrock stop and Anthropic results bodies are carved out of the generic shape check in __skipShape.
